correctness.rationale: The regular quadratic polynomial P(z) has adjugate-vector numerator p(z)=adj(P(z))b with each coordinate degree≤2n−2. At nonzero nonsingular center ξ, x(z)=z p(z)/det P(z); an annihilating functional vanishing on derivatives orders 0..2n−2 forces ℓ(p) to have a zero of multiplicity 2n−1 at ξ and therefore ℓ(p)≡0. Finite-dimensional annihilator duality gives exact equality of the local solution-image span and those jets over the indicated real/complex field. For P(z)=I+(z−ξ)²diag(1,...,n), all real parameters give SPD matrices and the even/odd Taylor coefficients are paired multiples of K^j b. Vandermonde independence yields ranks min(n,1+floor(m/2)); order 2n−2 is necessary for n≥2, with n=1 valid at order zero. Independently constructed rational-rank tests checked n=1..7 and their exact sharp threshold.
